# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `task docs:config` from the `env:` tags of config.Config. Do not edit. -->

Every variable the server reads. Required variables fail startup when missing. The Helm chart renders each of them from `values.yaml` (a test enforces it), and `.env.example` documents each for local runs. Cross-field rules live in `Config.Validate`.

Open-ended family (not listed below): `AEDST_DATABASE_URL_<MODULE>` and `AEDST_DATABASE_URL_<MODULE>_JOBS` point one module at its own database (database-per-module); an unknown module name fails startup.

## Core

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEDST_ENV` | string | `development` |  |

## HTTP

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEDST_HTTP_ADDR` | string | `:8080` |  |
| `AEDST_METRICS_ADDR` | string | (empty) | MetricsAddr is the listen address of the optional Prometheus scrape endpoint (/metrics). Empty disables it; OTLP push is unaffected. |
| `AEDST_PPROF_ENABLED` | bool | `false` | PprofEnabled serves net/http/pprof under /debug/pprof/ on the metrics listener (never the public port). It needs AEDST_METRICS_ADDR. Heap and goroutine profiles expose process internals: reach it by port-forward only. |
| `AEDST_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | int | `15` |  |
| `AEDST_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS` | int | `0` | ShutdownDrainSeconds is how long /readyz reports not-ready before the listener stops accepting, so a load balancer can drain the instance. Set to the LB's health-check interval x threshold in production. |
| `AEDST_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | int | `30` |  |
| `AEDST_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES` | int | `1048576` | MaxRequestBytes caps a single RPC request message. |
| `AEDST_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | list | `http://localhost:3000` | AllowedOrigins lists the browser origins (e.g. apps/web in local dev) permitted to call the ConnectRPC API cross-origin. Connect's protocol is plain HTTP/JSON so browsers can call it directly (see docs/content/decisions/0002-connectrpc.md), but that still requires CORS. |
| `AEDST_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS` | int | `0` | TrustedProxyHops is the exact number of reverse proxies between the public internet and this server (Cloudflare -> ALB = 2). 0 means the socket peer is the client. Wrong values let clients spoof the IP used for rate limiting, so verify after deploying (see internal/platform/clientip). |
| `AEDST_AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | int | `30` | AuthRateLimitPerMinute is the per-client-IP budget for the public authentication RPCs (register/login/refresh). 0 disables. |
| `AEDST_AUTH_FAIL_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | int | `60` | AuthFailRateLimitPerMinute is the per-client-IP budget of failed authentications (missing or invalid bearer token) on authenticated RPCs; once spent, that address gets RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED until the window passes. Successful requests cost nothing. 0 disables. |
| `AEDST_API_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | int | `1200` | APIRateLimitPerMinute is the per-user budget for authenticated RPCs, shared by every replica through Valkey. It bounds what one account (or one leaked token) can take from everyone else. 0 disables. |
| `AEDST_MAX_IN_FLIGHT` | int | `1024` | MaxInFlight caps concurrently processing requests per instance; the excess is shed with 429 + Retry-After rather than queued until latency collapses. 0 disables. |
| `AEDST_GRPC_REFLECTION_ENABLED` | bool | `false` | GRPCReflectionEnabled serves gRPC server reflection (schema discovery for grpcurl and similar). Off by default: it publishes the whole API surface to anyone who can reach the port. |

## Database

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEDST_DATABASE_URL` | string | **required** |  |
| `AEDST_DATABASE_MAX_CONNS` | int | `20` |  |
| `AEDST_DATABASE_MIN_CONNS` | int | `2` |  |
| `AEDST_DATABASE_MAX_CONN_LIFETIME_MINUTES` | int | `60` | MaxConnLifetimeMinutes recycles connections so a failover/DNS change is picked up and server-side memory does not grow unbounded. |
| `AEDST_DATABASE_MAX_CONN_IDLE_MINUTES` | int | `15` |  |
| `AEDST_DATABASE_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS` | int | `15000` | StatementTimeoutMs aborts runaway queries server-side (0 = no limit). |
| `AEDST_DATABASE_IDLE_IN_TX_TIMEOUT_MS` | int | `30000` | IdleInTxTimeoutMs kills sessions that hold a transaction open while idle (0 = no limit). |
| `AEDST_DATABASE_JOBS_MAX_CONNS` | int | `30` | JobsMaxConns sizes the second pool used by background work (River, event consumers). Keeping it apart from MaxConns means a burst of jobs can only exhaust its own connections, never the ones request handlers need — and a slow request storm cannot starve the workers either. Budget: replicas x (MaxConns + JobsMaxConns) must stay below Postgres max_connections (or PgBouncer's server pool). |
| `AEDST_DATABASE_DIRECT_DSN` | string | (empty) | DirectDSN, when set, is used by the jobs pool instead of DSN. Point DSN at PgBouncer (transaction pooling) for request traffic and DirectDSN at Postgres itself: River uses LISTEN/NOTIFY and platform/lock uses session-level advisory locks, neither of which survives transaction pooling. |
| `AEDST_DATABASE_READ_URL` | string | (empty) | ReadDSN, when set, opens a third pool (modulekit.Env.ReadPool) on a read replica (CloudNativePG "-ro" service, an RDS reader endpoint). Only modules whose queries tolerate replica lag use it (search today); every write and every read-your-writes path stays on AEDST_DATABASE_URL. Empty = ReadPool is the primary pool. It sits behind the same AEDST_DATABASE_POOLER mode as the primary. See docs/content/server/runbook-postgres-scaling.md. |
| `AEDST_DATABASE_READ_MAX_CONNS` | int | `0` | ReadMaxConns sizes the read pool (0 = same as AEDST_DATABASE_MAX_CONNS). Budget it like the others: replicas x ReadMaxConns counts against the replica's max_connections. |
| `AEDST_DATABASE_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_TLS` | bool | `false` | AllowUnverifiedTLS is the explicit opt-out of the requirement that every DSN in staging and production uses sslmode=verify-full or verify-ca. |
| `AEDST_DATABASE_POOLER` | string | `none` | Pooler declares the connection pooler in front of AEDST_DATABASE_URL: "none" (default; direct Postgres or a session-mode pooler) or "pgbouncer" (PgBouncer / CloudNativePG Pooler in transaction mode). With "pgbouncer" the API pool is forced onto pgx QueryExecModeCacheDescribe (no named prepared statements) regardless of the DSN, and Validate requires AEDST_DATABASE_DIRECT_DSN or AEDST_JOBS_POLL_ONLY=true, because River's LISTEN/NOTIFY does not work through transaction pooling. |

## Valkey

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEDST_VALKEY_ADDR` | string | `localhost:6379` |  |
| `AEDST_VALKEY_PASSWORD` | string | (empty) |  |
| `AEDST_VALKEY_DB` | int | `0` |  |
| `AEDST_VALKEY_TLS` | bool | `false` | TLS connects to Valkey over TLS (TLS 1.2+). Required in staging and production unless AllowPlaintext is set: the password and every rate-limit key would otherwise cross the network in clear. |
| `AEDST_VALKEY_TLS_SERVER_NAME` | string | (empty) | TLSServerName is the name verified in the server certificate (default: the host of AEDST_VALKEY_ADDR). |
| `AEDST_VALKEY_TLS_CA_FILE` | string | (empty) | TLSCAFile is a PEM bundle of the CA that signed the server certificate (default: the system roots). |
| `AEDST_VALKEY_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT` | bool | `false` | AllowPlaintext is the explicit opt-out of the TLS requirement, for a Valkey inside a trusted network segment. |

## Auth

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEDST_AUTH_FIRST_PARTY_ENABLED` | bool | `false` |  |
| `AEDST_AUTH_FIRST_PARTY_SUNSET` | string | (empty) | FirstPartySunset is the RFC 3339 date/time after which first-party auth must be gone (e.g. 2027-03-31 or 2027-03-31T00:00:00Z). Required when FirstPartyEnabled outside development; once it has passed, staging and production refuse to start and development logs an error. |
| `AEDST_JWT_SIGNING_KEY` | string | (empty) | JWTSigningKey is the HS256 secret for first-party tokens (>= 32 bytes). Rotation: move the old key to JWTPreviousSigningKey (verify-only). |
| `AEDST_JWT_PREVIOUS_SIGNING_KEY` | string | (empty) |  |
| `AEDST_ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES` | int | `15` |  |
| `AEDST_REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_HOURS` | int | `720` |  |
| `AEDST_LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | int | `10` | LoginRateLimitPerMinute is the per-account budget for password attempts (independent of the per-IP limit). 0 disables. |
| `AEDST_ROLE_POLICY` | map | (empty) | RolePolicy restricts procedures to callers holding one of the listed roles: "/pkg.Service/Method=role\|role,/pkg.Other/Method=role". A procedure that is unknown or public is a startup error (see httpserver.ValidateRolePolicy), so a typo cannot leave the real RPC open. Empty means every authenticated caller may call every RPC. |

## OIDC

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEDST_OIDC_ISSUER` | string | (empty) | Issuer is the provider's issuer URL; discovery is fetched from <issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration. |
| `AEDST_OIDC_AUDIENCE` | string | (empty) | Audience is the value that must appear in the token's aud claim (typically the API's client id / project id). |
| `AEDST_OIDC_JWKS_URL` | string | (empty) | JWKSURL overrides the jwks_uri found in discovery (rarely needed). |
| `AEDST_OIDC_ALGORITHMS` | list | `RS256,ES256,EdDSA` | Algorithms is the allow-list of accepted JWS algorithms. Asymmetric only: HS* is refused for external issuers (algorithm-confusion guard). |
| `AEDST_OIDC_TOKEN_TYPES` | list | `at+jwt,JWT` | TokenTypes is the allow-list of the JOSE header typ of an access token: "at+jwt" (RFC 9068) and "JWT" (Keycloak and others). A token with another typ, or none, is rejected, which keeps ID and logout tokens out. |
| `AEDST_OIDC_ROLES_CLAIM` | string | `roles` | RolesClaim locates roles in the token: a top-level claim name or a dotted path. ZITADEL: "urn:zitadel:iam:org:project:roles" (an object keyed by role name); Keycloak: "realm_access.roles". An array of strings or an object keyed by role name are both understood. |
| `AEDST_OIDC_ROLES_ORG` | string | (empty) | RolesOrg (optional) is an organisation id. For an object-shaped roles claim ({role: {orgId: domain}}, ZITADEL: roles are bound to an organisation) only roles granted in that organisation count. Empty = any. |
| `AEDST_OIDC_CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS` | int | `30` |  |

## Client

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEDST_MIN_CLIENT_VERSIONS` | map | (empty) | MinVersions maps a client platform (web, android, apple, desktop) to the oldest release the server still supports, e.g. "android=1.2.0,apple=1.2.0". Requests from an older, self-identified client are rejected with CLIENT_UPGRADE_REQUIRED. Empty disables the gate; a request that does not identify itself is never rejected. |
| `AEDST_RECOMMENDED_CLIENT_VERSIONS` | map | (empty) | RecommendedVersions is the soft counterpart: the release clients should move to. Nothing is rejected; GetCapabilities reports it and clients show a non-blocking update prompt. Same format as MinVersions. |
| `AEDST_FEATURES` | string | (empty) | FeaturesJSON are operator-controlled feature flags, returned by GetCapabilities: {"new_search":{"enabled":true,"params":{"rollout_percent":"25"}}}. Values are re-read only on restart (a Helm value change rolls the pods). |

## Retention

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEDST_RETENTION_INTERVAL_MINUTES` | int | `60` | IntervalMinutes is how often each retention policy runs. |
| `AEDST_RETENTION_IDEMPOTENCY_HOURS` | int | `48` | IdempotencyHours is how long an idempotency key is remembered: it only has to outlive a client's retry window. |
| `AEDST_RETENTION_TOMBSTONE_HOURS` | int | `336` | TombstoneHours is how long the search projection keeps deletion tombstones. It must exceed the longest event redelivery window (River's retry backoff over 10 attempts, ~4.3 h), or a late old snapshot could resurrect a deleted document. |
| `AEDST_RETENTION_SESSION_HOURS` | int | `720` | SessionHours is how long an expired or revoked session row is kept (for audit and support) before deletion. |
| `AEDST_RETENTION_NOTIFICATION_DAYS` | int | `90` | NotificationDays is how long in-app notifications are kept. |
| `AEDST_RETENTION_AUDIT_DAYS` | int | `365` | AuditDays is how long admin audit entries are kept. |

## Server

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEDST_HTTP_READ_HEADER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | int | `5` |  |
| `AEDST_HTTP_READ_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | int | `30` |  |
| `AEDST_HTTP_WRITE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | int | `60` | WriteTimeoutSeconds must exceed AEDST_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS so a timed-out RPC can still be answered. Streaming RPCs clear it per request. |
| `AEDST_HTTP_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | int | `120` |  |
| `AEDST_HTTP_MAX_HEADER_BYTES` | int | `65536` |  |
| `AEDST_TLS_CERT_FILE` | string | (empty) | TLSCertFile/TLSKeyFile enable in-process TLS (min TLS 1.2). The default deployment terminates TLS at the ingress/load balancer instead. |
| `AEDST_TLS_KEY_FILE` | string | (empty) |  |
| `AEDST_HSTS_MAX_AGE_SECONDS` | int | `63072000` | HSTSMaxAgeSeconds is sent as Strict-Transport-Security on HTTPS requests (directly or via a trusted proxy's X-Forwarded-Proto). 0 disables. |
| `AEDST_REQUIRE_CONNECT_PROTOCOL_HEADER` | bool | `true` | RequireConnectProtocolHeader rejects Connect unary requests without the Connect-Protocol-Version header (CSRF defense in depth; every official Connect client sends it). |

## Jobs

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEDST_JOBS_QUEUES` | map | `default=50,media=2` | Queues maps queue -> max concurrent workers, e.g. "default=50,media=2". A dedicated media worker deployment runs "media=4" and API replicas "default=50"; an empty value makes the process insert-only. |
| `AEDST_JOBS_POLL_ONLY` | bool | `false` | PollOnly runs River without LISTEN/NOTIFY (river.Config.PollOnly): jobs are picked up by polling (slightly higher latency, more idle queries). Required for the jobs pool to sit behind a transaction pooler when no AEDST_DATABASE_DIRECT_DSN is available. Prefer the direct DSN. |
| `AEDST_JOBS_COMPLETED_RETENTION_HOURS` | int | `24` | Completed/Cancelled/DiscardedRetentionHours are how long River keeps finished jobs (River's cleaner deletes them afterwards). Event deliveries are River jobs, so this is the retention of the event log: completed ones are only kept for dedupe/inspection, discarded ones are the dead-letter list and live longest. |
| `AEDST_JOBS_CANCELLED_RETENTION_HOURS` | int | `24` |  |
| `AEDST_JOBS_DISCARDED_RETENTION_HOURS` | int | `168` |  |
